title: Select Block configuration costs reduced until supplies last
subject: Select Block configuration costs reduced until supplies last
body:
Time-Limited Availability & Cost Reduction for 30TB TLC and 60TB QLC Drives

Dear {Partner name},

As we continue to navigate a highly volatile cost market, Hitachi Vantara is working very closely with our internal teams to provide better visibility and faster deal turnaround to help support deal velocity and protect your margins.

We are pleased to announce we have been able to secure inventory of 30TB TLC drives and 60TB QLC drives for our Hitachi Virtual Storage Platform One (VSP One) Block 2x and VSP One Block 85 product ranges, which will give us greater commercial flexibility on deals that include these products until March 31, 2027, or as long as supplies last.

Effective immediately, we encourage you to use these drives in your configurations as much as possible to benefit from the commercial edge they provide. This is a tremendous opportunity to boost sales and increase your win rate.

Please contact me if you have any questions.

Thank you,
{PAM name}
